skills.name: register-data-connector
skills.description: Register a bring-your-own-data (BYO-data) connector on a user''s NuBerea account so their own data becomes queryable through the NuBerea MCP server. Use this when a user asks to "connect my data", "add a data source", "register a connector", "expose my Hugging Face dataset / AWS data catalog to NuBerea", or to create the tenant → trust → connector → tool chain. This skill drives the NuBerea SDK CLI (`@nuberea/sdk`), which handles OAuth sign-in and the catalog control plane. Supports two connector kinds: hf_dataset (Hugging Face Parquet datasets, public or gated) and glue_athena (AWS Glue Data Catalog + Athena over the user''s own S3, via secretless OIDC trust).
headings: use a global install only if it's new enough to include `catalog`;
otherwise fall back to the published package via npx
Step 0 — Find or create the tenant
→ user applies the OIDC provider + read-only role in THEIR aws account
Step 3 — Register tool(s) (optional but usually wanted)
let NuBerea draft tools from the connector schema, then register approved ones
or author one directly (see reference.md for the JSON shape + SQL rules)
